email.subject1: a signal play for dbt Labs
email.body1:
Annie, saw dbt Labs just merged with Fivetran to build the data infrastructure for agents.

A merger that big usually means more accounts in play across two install bases than the team can cover while the combined motion settles, and that is where pipeline leaks before it reaches sales. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for dbt Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Annie, quick follow-up for dbt Labs.

Post-merger, pipeline expectations climb faster than headcount as the two demand engines combine. Most revenue teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings dbt Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Annie, last bit of proof for dbt Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how dbt Labs' reply rate likely compares to similar data companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Annie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and integrating a merger is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I will tailor it to dbt Labs either way.
